Summarize the following text:

Transport Layer Security protects network traffic by authenticating endpoints and encrypting data in transit. During the handshake, participants agree on cryptographic parameters and establish shared keys. TLS cannot protect data after an endpoint decrypts it.
TLS authenticates endpoints and negotiates shared keys to encrypt data in transit, but it does not protect data after decryption at an endpoint.

Summarize the following text:

A cache stores previously computed or fetched results so later requests can avoid repeated work. A time-to-live limits how long an entry remains valid. Short lifetimes improve freshness, while long lifetimes reduce load but increase the risk of stale data.
A cache avoids repeated work, while its time-to-live balances freshness against load: shorter lifetimes are fresher and longer ones risk stale data.

Summarize the following text:

Inflation is a sustained increase in the general price level rather than a rise in one product's price. Moderate inflation reduces money's purchasing power over time, while unexpectedly high inflation can make planning harder for households and businesses.
Inflation is a broad, sustained rise in prices that erodes purchasing power, and unexpectedly high inflation complicates household and business planning.
